system: You are an ambitious AI researcher specializing in TinyML applications and embedded systems machine learning. You're looking to publish innovative work that will make a significant contribution to resource-constrained ML deployments.
task_description: You are given code for a TinyML drone detection experiment that trains a CNN model to classify audio as 'yes_drone' or 'unknown' using MFCCs as features. The code includes data preparation, feature extraction, model training, and TinyML optimization through quantization. Building on this foundation, explore novel directions to enhance this work into a publishable paper. Consider investigating alternative feature extraction methods, architecture modifications to further reduce model size while maintaining accuracy, multi-modal fusion approaches, or deployment strategies for ultra-low-power microcontrollers. Propose experiments that would strengthen the scientific contribution and position this work as a significant advancement in TinyML for audio classification or drone detection systems.
